examples.en: Hello and welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
Say you wake up feeling sick.
Your body might not be able to work, but your brain STILL can.
Today I want to talk about challenging yourself, stepping out of your comfort zone and being the dumbest person in the room.

usages.usage: right now 中的 right 加強「現在」的語氣。

usages.usage: make mistakes 表示「犯錯」，不是製作錯誤。
get better 表示狀態變好。
examples: Meanwhile, I was just stumbling, forgetting every step.

breakdowns.sentence: Hello and welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
breakdowns.translation: 然後把這段影片放到1.25或1.5倍。

points.label: to 不定詞
points.note: 表示目的、結果或補充前面的動作。

breakdowns.sentence: So, if you think you're ready for faster listening, then put this video in times 1.25 or 1.5.
breakdowns.translation: 因為……被這樣的人包圍是令人生畏的。

points.label: if 條件句
points.note: 用 if 子句提出條件，再說明結果或想像情況。

breakdowns.sentence: Why would you want to be the best dancer in the room?
breakdowns.translation: 沒有人讓我感到難為情或不安全。

points.label: would 假設與委婉語氣
points.note: 用 would 表示假設情境、可能性或較委婉的說法。

breakdowns.sentence: When was the last time you put yourself in a room where everyone was better than you at something?

points.label: when 時間子句
points.note: 說明事情發生的時間或情境。

breakdowns.sentence: Your body might not be able to work, but your brain STILL can.
breakdowns.translation: 你可以告訴每個人所有可怕的事情。

points.label: be able to 能力句型
points.text: be + able + to + 原形動詞
points.note: 表示某人有能力或有機會做到某件事。
